method: Constructed 8-way grid paths entirely in actual same-net copper union. 0.1mm grid, segment sampling <=0.04mm. Changes of layer only at real same-net via/PTH centers, charged the actual board thickness. Source starts at F.Cu center of connector PTH. These are constructible path upper bounds, not sums of all branches, electrical delay or a field-solver result. Copper footprints/trace width can shorten center-line distances. No 90-ohm impedance certification. Intended USB Full Speed 12 Mbit/s.
threshold_note: Track/via/drill thresholds checked from actual geometry. Copper spacing requires native DRC and/or separate pair-shape threshold check; global rule setting alone is not evidence of actual spacing.
